title: 1981-04-16_Pat_92.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops a unified theological-cosmological system interpreting the 2-3-74 visionary experience through evolutionary convergence theory and Christological metaphysics. He argues that perception and cognition of 'temporal location' reveal a macro-organism assembling itself across history—from Torah through Christ to a final stage of distributed personal scripture (Joachim's Age). He proposes that the Ditheon dream (two psyches unified into one being) models how disparate sub-divine components converge toward a cosmic Christ through pairing, mirroring, and integration, with the plasmate and VALIS as intermediate manifestations of this evolutionary process.
key_claims: Human consciousness discovers an evolutionary macro-totality ordered by change-rate velocities and temporal location (not just spatial location), revealing reality's hidden unitary structure.

The Golden Fish sign's paradox—appearing at two times and places simultaneously yet unitary—triggered cognitive recognition that the brain performs meta-abstraction, distinguishing signal from what was always-present ground.
Torah, Christ, and the distributed personal scripture of Joachim's Age represent three evolutionary stages of a single informational organism, not competing scriptures.
The Ditheon—two human psyches unified into a transcendent being—models how the cosmic macro-organism assembles itself from subordinate components while remaining one unified entity.
Point Omega (Teilhard) occurs through this same pairing principle: disparate elements throughout history and cosmos converge into the final unified Cosmic Christ.

Reality is camouflage of unfinished assembly: we cannot perceive the cosmic entity's totality because its parts are still dispersed and will only become visible when fully integrated at the end of time.

tensions: Ubik as theoretical vs. empirical: the novel realized it intellectually before PKD's visionary experience made it perceptual and cognitive.
Whether the entity is camouflaged or simply unfinished: PKD corrects himself—it is not hidden by deception but invisible due to incompleteness.
How can sub-divine parts assemble into the divine?: tension between composition and transcendence; the organism metaphor vs. mechanical metaphor.
Jewish vs. Christian scripture: PKD argues both are evolutionary stages of one organism, but neither tradition understands this. Revolutionary but likely unacceptable to both communities.
Why can't the forces of Darkness perceive assembly?: they see the parts but not the integration pattern—incomplete knowledge or willful blindness?
Individual uniqueness vs. unified totality: how can humans remain plural and unique while becoming part of a singular macro-organism? PKD claims both are true simultaneously.
Whether this is mystical experience or rational theology: PKD fuses perception, cognition, reason, and revelation as equal epistemological sources.
evidence_quotes: This vast compound entity has no enemies bolling the universe back to the uttered word—through abstraction to that which is pre-existent—is to 'retrieve' this living structure (which is evolving) out of creation.
An assembly of sub-divine components [brought together] should produce [in evolution] the divine—this is the great mystery revealed to me.
The missing parts are added to him because he is added to it. The wedding of opposites is seen as a tactic and goal of biological evolution.
Humans subordinated to a compound organism by which they are perfected as individuals and it is completed as a whole.

This is why we can't see it (the entity). It is still in its disparate subassemblies. And until they come together, what I call 'camouflaged' it isn't camouflaged. We just can't see how all the parts here and there when they finally come together will be the macro-Christ.
uncertainty_flags: MMSK: Acronym used repeatedly but never explicitly defined in this passage. Likely 'Macro-Mind or Meta-Structural Knowledge' but unclear.
What is BTA?: Referenced as a framework that synthesizes with Russ's letter and the Ditheon dream; exact source unknown.
Who is Russ?: Correspondent whose letter triggered PKD's breakthrough; identity and full text not provided.
Hagia Sophia reference: passage fragment about child-play and Sophia's regeneration is garbled/truncated ('Child born Hagia Sophae who plays').
Tractate entry #2: Reference to 'time ceases and the mind is complete' suggests a systematic theological document; unclear if formal or PKD's own.
July 2, 1981 at 4:00 AM: Timestamp of breakthrough noted but no record of what external event or communication triggered it.
Application to communications media: PKD claims the noosphere/pairing system extends to communications but doesn't elaborate.
Distinction between plasmate and Ditheon: Both seem to be stages of the same assembly process but relationship unclear.
